verdicts.why: Radcliffe sends Fitz through in episode 86 and he wakes at Ivanov's platform (in the Baltic), then remembers his deeds in isolation in episode 87; Siberia is wrong. The app's own place name for the platform is "Ivanov's oil platform", not "The Baltic Sea".
Wikipedia: Joy drugs Danny and has him institutionalized at the end of episode 1; in episode 2 Ward orders his men, disguised as patients, to kill him.
Episode 13: Ward allies with Rand, Wing and Temple, shoots Harold, who falls from the building to his death, and has the body cremated so he does not return. The file lacks this.

Episode 4: Walker is the core personality and Mary the alter; Walker, working for Joy and Davos, attacks, drugs and takes Rand to the ritual that moves the Iron Fist to Davos. No violent self takes over.

value.text: When Fury sees through his disguise, Talos tries to kill him. He then follows Vers to Maria Rambeau's home, where he reveals that the Skrulls are refugees and wins her help.

verdicts.why: The status fix is right: at Rambeau's home Talos arrives unarmed, reveals the Skrulls are refugees and allies with Danvers. But the evidence is wrong that he does not try to kill Fury: the MCU wiki says that once his cover is blown he tries to disarm and kill Fury until Vers stuns him, so that clause stays.
Episode 6: in the Citadel at the End of Time, Sylvie sends Loki back to the TVA and kills He Who Remains, unleashing a multiverse the TVA cannot prune.

value.text: Spider-Man fights Tarantula aboard a passenger boat near the Williamsburg Bridge and captures him.

verdicts.why: The MCU wiki says Spider-Man confronts and apprehends Tarantula on a public passenger boat near the Williamsburg Bridge, so In custody and the location fix hold. The 'smuggling operation' detail carries a citation-needed tag there and is dropped.

value.text: In episode 55, corrupt Colombian police colonel Ramon executes Elena's cousin Francisco and holds Hunter and Morse captive, until Mack knocks him out.

verdicts.why: When S.H.I.E.L.D. storms the station, Mack knocks Ramon out (AoS311), so At large is wrong. His jailing is only stated in Slingshot (a later title), so 'and he is jailed' is cut.

The MCU wiki puts Zip's move from Shades to Diamondback in episode 9 ('Recruited by Diamondback', LC109). Wikipedia says Diamondback makes him his secondary advisor. Episode 11's siege and escape are not described in this record.

Wikipedia: Taserface's mutiny imprisons Yondu and Rocket; Kraglin and Groot free them; they join the fight against Ego; Yondu dies in space saving Quill; Ravagers arrive at his funeral and accept him again.

There are five summoned hunters including Jack Russell, who survives, so the current text is false. Of the other four, Elsa kills one in the maze, Ted kills another, and Elsa kills the remaining two: three by Elsa and one by Ted.
Secret Wars is episodes 61-63. In episode 63 ('Chapter III: Doom') Doom is defeated and the Beyonder erases the heroes' memories and sends them home. Episode 64 starts Spider Wars.
The Storm and Invisible Woman lab recharge is in episode 61 ('Chapter I: Arrival'). The record describes nothing from episode 63.
Episode 2: Butane is hired to destroy a building as part of an insurance scam; Peter subdues him and sees the infinity logo. Episode 3 is the Vasquez/Sanders robbery.

The sources disagree: Wikipedia says power plant, while the Marvel Animated wiki has Electro guarding the High Evolutionary's base, Wundagore Castle, and beaten in its main power core. 'Tower' is not clearly wrong, so this is closer to rewording.
